def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and r == h - r - 1:
            candidates.append(('row', r))
    for c in range(w):
        if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c == w - c - 1:
            candidates.append(('col', c))
    assert candidates
    # The separator divides the grid into two equal-sized panels.
    orientation, s = candidates[0]
    if orientation == 'row':
        a, b = grid[:s], grid[s + 1:]
        height, width = len(a), len(a[0])
    else:
        a = [row[:s] for row in grid]
        b = [row[s + 1:] for row in grid]
        height, width = h, len(a[0])
    shared = set(v for row in a for v in row) & set(v for row in b for v in row)
    assert len(shared) == 1
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_col = next((c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1), None)
    if sep_col is not None:
        a = [row[:sep_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        assert len(a[0]) == len(b[0])
        height, width = h, len(a[0])
    else:
        sep_row = next(r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1)
        a, b = grid[:sep_row], grid[sep_row + 1:]
        assert len(a) == len(b)
        height, width = len(a), w

    bg_a = Counter(x for row in a for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bg_b = Counter(x for row in b for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors_a = {x for row in a for x in row}
    colors_b = {x for row in b for x in row}
    shared = colors_a & colors_b
    targets = shared - {bg_a, bg_b}
    if targets:
        # A color represented in both panels is the output background; mark
        # its aligned occurrences in the two panels.
        color = next(iter(targets))
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == color and b[r][c] == color else color
                 for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]

    # With only the shared background color, mark cells occupied in either panel.
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] != bg_a or b[r][c] != bg_b else color
             for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
